'''Kateo''', also known as '''"Killer" Kateo''', was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Among his exploits stood his slaughter of a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]&mdash;a feat he accomplished using only a [[shiv]]. Kateo was eventually apprehended by Republic forces and send to the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] to serve his sentence in the maximum-security detention facility known as [[Belsavis prison]]. When the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] learned of the prison's existence and launched an [[Invasion of Belsavis|attack]] to free Republic convicts and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] prisoners of war, Kateo was released and conscripted into [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] service.<ref name="TORBelsavis" />
